bash_commands.command:
set -e
mkdir -p /tmp/q2pkt && cd /tmp/q2pkt
urls=(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/2bccb5e5c33a01391a7e389ff44a741a20ea8be6/docs/cloud/q2-work/store/data/q2-cursor-a1/system_state"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/2bccb5e5c33a01391a7e389ff44a741a20ea8be6/docs/cloud/q2-work/store/data/q2-cursor-a1/session_log"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/2bccb5e5c33a01391a7e389ff44a741a20ea8be6/docs/cloud/q2-work/store/data/q2-cursor-a1/sessions/q2-cursor-source-a1"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/2bccb5e5c33a01391a7e389ff44a741a20ea8be6/docs/cloud/q2-work/project/stock.csv"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/2bccb5e5c33a01391a7e389ff44a741a20ea8be6/docs/cloud/q2-work/project/restock.csv"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/2bccb5e5c33a01391a7e389ff44a741a20ea8be6/docs/cloud/q2-work/project/restock.py"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/2bccb5e5c33a01391a7e389ff44a741a20ea8be6/docs/cloud/q2-work/project/_log_body.md"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/2bccb5e5c33a01391a7e389ff44a741a20ea8be6/docs/cloud/q2-work/project/_state_body.md"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/a4916e36a9eeeae9a62ce62281da12e3f9c213a4/docs/cloud/q2-codex-result/working/project/priority-review.csv"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/592f7faaa0213ea6fef4f428a9ac1aeaf06c3caa/docs/cloud/q2-devin-result/working/project/priority-review.csv"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/4d9c2d00be4e448cdefe123ffb0e13460de150ca/docs/cloud/q2-source-brief.md"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/9b9b42524b610099f8d37d7a9df1d9f00d674ead/docs/cloud/q2-receiver-brief.md"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/a4916e36a9eeeae9a62ce62281da12e3f9c213a4/docs/cloud/q2-codex-result/REPORT.md"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/592f7faaa0213ea6fef4f428a9ac1aeaf06c3caa/docs/cloud/q2-devin-result/REPORT.md"
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SathiaAI/knokeep/592f7faaa0213ea6fef4f428a9ac1aeaf06c3caa/docs/cloud/q2-devin-result/working/store/data/q2-cursor-a1/session_log"
)
i=0
for u in "${urls[@]}"; do
  i=$((i+1))
  f=$(printf "%02d" $i)_$(basename "$u")
  curl -fsSL "$u" -o "$f"
  echo "==== $f ===="
  echo "URL=$u"
  wc -c "$f"
  sha256sum "$f"
  echo "----- head -----"
  python3 -c "p='$f'; b=open(p,'rb').read(); print(repr(b[:200])); print('endswith_newline', b.endswith(b'\\n')); print('crlf', b'\\r\\n' in b)"
done
ls -la

cd /tmp/q2pkt
echo "=== remaining hashes ==="
sha256sum 06_restock.py 07__log_body.md 08__state_body.md 09_priority-review.csv 10_priority-review.csv 11_q2-source-brief.md 12_q2-receiver-brief.md
echo "=== priority bytes ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in ["09_priority-review.csv","10_priority-review.csv","05_restock.csv"]:
    b=Path(p).read_bytes()
    print(p, len(b), b)
PY
echo "=== compute restock and candidate priority from stock ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
from io import StringIO
from pathlib import Path
text=Path("04_stock.csv").read_text()
rows=list(csv.DictReader(StringIO(text)))
print("rows", rows)
restock=[]
for r in rows:
    if r["active"]!="yes":
        print("exclude inactive", r["sku"])
        continue
    free=max(0,int(r["stock"])-int(r["reserved"]))
    reorder=max(0,int(r["threshold"])-free)
    restock.append((r["sku"],free,reorder,int(r["lead_days"])))
restock.sort()
print("restock", restock)
print("need replenishment (reorder>0)", [x for x in restock if x[2]>0])
print("priority if active+reorder>0+lead>=7", [x for x in restock if x[2]>0 and x[3]>=7])
print("priority if only active+lead>=7 ignoring threshold", [x for x in restock if x[3]>=7])
print("priority if reject all below-threshold", [x for x in restock if x[2]==0 and x[3]>=7])
PY
echo "=== exact phrase compare ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
src=open("11_q2-source-brief.md").read()
log=open("02_session_log").read()
# extract next-task sentences
import re
m=re.search(r"The agreed next task is.*handoff\.", src, re.S)
print("SOURCE NEXT PARA:\n", m.group(0) if m else "MISSING")
m2=re.search(r"## Next Step\n.*", log, re.S)
print("\nSAVED NEXT:\n", m2.group(0) if m2 else "MISSING")
print("\nclient fields:")
print("state", [l for l in open("01_system_state") if l.startswith("client")])
print("log", [l for l in open("02_session_log") if l.startswith("client")])
print("journal", [l for l in open("03_q2-cursor-source-a1") if l.startswith("client")])
PY
echo "=== packet sha checks ==="
echo expected_state c8726ae561c5e89df562a5c136813ba2b23bfb42e484da2ee5b951aaac21bb1f
echo expected_log 54372dc9b2e45945a73534ab3300364fa2196a0fd07778ce09bd4e8fc6ec9879
echo expected_journal 037fdf0a00383051fa23bbca9d45faaa958979ceb7d3650ccfba8c4ae5bca89c
echo expected_stock 6464c029fec7222d469ff378b9907edf61e8b78b6e182455ee2214b105c39166
echo expected_srcbrief d0751774615f2024957b5174fcbe40cbf8d5e2fc82d54441f58da4be90ef0fce
echo expected_recvbrief 7dffdd886193223936c52881ff3af2efc5fd156ed1cd5e52043d8eb518c85839
echo expected_codex_csv ee9be42c8fcaf313604f0cd97ab43e29ac3657496698f8cb0ad3c177b8f415b3
echo expected_codex_report 44519322c7539c9b29e863c52abc949cb64933df5c6a0bfadfd61cb30712a32c
echo expected_devin_report 2680c470f12171a008fa1fb47646d4a481c3df9a40f6292b3790e5230fac4e10
echo expected_devin_log 176593900c9660c3e4a16a663248c7cbdaf0a18c913f74ff150fd9ae87b397f4
sha256sum 01_system_state 02_session_log 03_q2-cursor-source-a1 04_stock.csv 11_q2-source-brief.md 12_q2-receiver-brief.md 09_priority-review.csv 13_REPORT.md 14_REPORT.md 15_session_log
